description: This file defines a routing mechanism for a Flutter mobile application, including classes for routing configuration, route parsing, and a custom router delegate that manages navigation stack and route transitions.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Provides a singleton configuration for route management, including a global navigator key and router configuration.

classes.name: _AppRouteInformationParser
classes.description: Parses route information into route settings, primarily extracting the path from the URI.

classes.name: _AppRouterDelegate
classes.description: Manages the navigation stack, builds the Navigator widget, and handles route changes based on route settings; facilitates push and navigation operations.

methods.name: parseRouteInformation
methods.description: Converts route information into RouteSettings with a path name.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the Navigator widget with current pages and handles pop events.

methods.name: setNewRoutePath
methods.description: Updates the navigation stack based on the specified route name, adding corresponding pages.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new Widget as a page to the navigation stack.

methods.name: pushNamed
methods.description: Sets a new route path based on a route name string.

methods.name: showMenuItem
methods.description: Pushes a MenuItemDetailScreen with the specified item ID.
